definitions.explanation: A fermenting mash of rice bran, salt and water in which vegetables are buried to make {糠漬|ぬかづ}け pickles. It is kept for years and must be stirred by hand regularly to stay healthy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{糠床|ぬかどこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かき{混|ま}ぜる→かき混ぜる：15739_kakimazeru⟧。
examples.english: I stir the rice-bran bed every day.

examples.japanese: {糠床|ぬかどこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧きゅうり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漬|つ}けた→漬ける：09861_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I buried cucumbers in the rice-bran bed to pickle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧{糠床|ぬかどこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{守|まも}っている→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: My mother carefully keeps the rice-bran bed that has been going since my grandmother's day.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A {糠床|ぬかどこ} is a living thing in a Japanese kitchen: it is stirred daily to let in air, topped up with fresh bran and salt, and often passed down in a family. Each household's bed gives its pickles a distinctive taste.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {糠床|ぬかどこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かき{混|ま}ぜる→かき混ぜる：15739_kakimazeru⟧: to stir the bran bed
- {糠床|ぬかどこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{漬|つ}ける→漬ける：09861_tsukeru⟧: to pickle in the bran bed
- {糠床|ぬかどこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to tend the bran bed

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{糠|ぬか}→糠：29202_nuka⟧: rice bran
